mapper.select:
SELECT s.id AS stock_id, p.id AS product_id, p.name, p.image, p.description, p.stock, s.min_stock, s.max_stock, s.alert_enabled, s.create_time AS created_at, s.update_time AS updated_at FROM products p LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.shop_id = p.shop_id
p.shop_id = #{shopId}
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')
ORDER BY p.stock ASC, p.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock (shop_id, product_id, alert_enabled, min_stock, max_stock, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{productId}, #{alertEnabled}, #{minStock}, #{maxStock}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
